arxiv-1803-07872.title: A differential game with exit costs
arxiv-1803-07872.creator: Fabio Bagagiolo, Rosario Maggistro, Marta Zoppello
arxiv-1803-07872.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Fabio Bagagiolo, Rosario Maggistro, Marta Zoppello. We study a differential game where two players separately control their own dynamics, pay a running cost, and moreover pay an exit cost (quitting the game) when they leave a fixed domain. In particular, each player has its own domain and the exit cost consists of three different exit costs, depending whether either the first player only leaves its domain, or the second player only leaves its domain, or they both simultaneously leave their own domain.

arxiv-2109-10423.title: Global well-posedness for the nonlinear generalized parabolic Anderson model equation
arxiv-2109-10423.creator: Qi Zhang
arxiv-2109-10423.description: Abstract We study the global existence of the singular nonlinear parabolic Anderson model equation on 2 2 -dimensional tours 𝕋 2 \mathbb{T}^{2} . The method is based on paracontrolled distribution and renormalization. After split the original nonlinear parabolic Anderson model equation into two simple equations, we prove the global well-posedness by some a priori estimates and smooth approximations.

arxiv-2210-05529.title: An Exploration of Hierarchical Attention Transformers for Efficient Long Document Classification
arxiv-2210-05529.creator: Ilias Chalkidis, Xiang Dai, Manos Fergadiotis, Prodromos Malakasiotis, Desmond Elliott † {\;\dagger} Department of Computer Science, University of Copenhagen, Denmark † {\;\dagger} CSIRO Data61, Sydney, Australia
arxiv-2210-05529.description: Abstract Non-hierarchical sparse attention Transformer-based models, such as Longformer and Big Bird, are popular approaches to working with long documents. There are clear benefits to these approaches compared to the original Transformer in terms of efficiency, but Hierarchical Attention Transformer (HAT) models are a vastly understudied alternative.

arxiv-2211-08974.title: Amphiphilic diblock copolymers as functional surfaces for protein chromatography
arxiv-2211-08974.creator: Raghu K. Moorthy, Serena D’Souza, P. Sunthar, Santosh B. Noronha
arxiv-2211-08974.description: Abstract Stationary phase plays a crucial role in the operation of a protein chromatography column. Conventional resins composed of acrylic polymers and their derivatives contribute to heterogeneity of the packing of stationary phase inside these columns. Alternative polymer combinations through customized surface functionalization schemes which consist of multiple steps using static coating techniques are well known.

arxiv-2303-10258.title: Künneth formulas for Cotor.
arxiv-2303-10258.creator: A. Salch
arxiv-2303-10258.description: Abstract . We investigate the question of how to compute the cotensor product, and more generally the derived cotensor (i.e., Cotor) groups, of a tensor product of comodules. In particular, we determine the conditions under which there is a Künneth formula for Cotor.

arxiv-2307-05186.title: A regularized Interior Point Method for sparse Optimal Transport on Graphs
arxiv-2307-05186.creator: Stefano Cipolla, Jacek Gondzio, Filippo Zanetti
arxiv-2307-05186.description: Abstract In this work, the authors address the Optimal Transport (OT) problem on graphs using a proximal stabilized Interior Point Method (IPM). In particular, strongly leveraging on the induced primal-dual regularization, the authors propose to solve large scale OT problems on sparse graphs using a bespoke IPM algorithm able to suitably exploit primal-dual regularization in order to enforce scalability.

arxiv-2308-09376.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for DRL-Based Anti-Jamming Strategies in Zero Touch Networks
arxiv-2308-09376.creator: Abubakar S. Ali, Dimitrios Michael Manias, Abdallah Shami, Sami Muhaidat
arxiv-2308-09376.description: Abstract As the dawn of sixth-generation (6G) networking approaches, it promises unprecedented advancements in communication and automation. Among the leading innovations of 6G is the concept of Zero Touch Networks (ZTNs), aiming to achieve fully automated, self-optimizing networks with minimal human intervention.

arxiv-2406-18340.title: Grammar Assistance Using Syntactic Structures (GAUSS)
arxiv-2406-18340.creator: Olga Zamaraeva, Lorena S. Allegue, Carlos Gómez-Rodríguez, Margarita Alonso-Ramos, Anastasiia Ogneva
arxiv-2406-18340.description: Abstract Automatic grammar coaching serves an important purpose of advising on standard grammar varieties while not imposing social pressures or reinforcing established social roles. Such systems already exist but most of them are for English and few of them offer meaningful feedback.

arxiv-2407-13313.title: Sortability of Time Series Data
arxiv-2407-13313.creator: Christopher Lohse, Jonas Wahl
arxiv-2407-13313.description: Abstract Evaluating the performance of causal discovery algorithms that aim to find causal relationships between time-dependent processes remains a challenging topic. In this paper, we show that certain characteristics of datasets, such as varsortability Reisach et al. 2021 and R 2 R^{2} -sortability Reisach et al. 2023 , also occur in datasets for autocorrelated stationary time series.

arxiv-2412-02735.title: CPP-UT-Bench: Can LLMs Write Complex Unit Tests in C++?
arxiv-2412-02735.creator: Vaishnavi Bhargava, Rajat Ghosh, Debojyoti Dutta
arxiv-2412-02735.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vaishnavi Bhargava, Rajat Ghosh, Debojyoti Dutta. We introduce CPP-UT-Bench, a benchmark dataset to measure C++ unit test generation capability of a large language model (LLM). CPP-UT-Bench aims to reflect a broad and diverse set of C++ codebases found in the real world. The dataset includes 2,653 {code, unit test} pairs drawn from 14 different opensource C++ codebases spanned across nine diverse domains including machine learning, software testing, parsing, standard input-output, data engineering, logging, complete expression evaluation, key value storage, and server protocols.

arxiv-2412-21163.title: Probing Heavy Axion-like Particles from Massive Stars with X X -rays and Gamma Rays
arxiv-2412-21163.creator: James H. Buckley a, P. S. Bhupal Dev a, Francesc Ferrer a, Takuya Okawa a,b
arxiv-2412-21163.description: Abstract The hot interiors of massive stars in the later stages of their evolution provide an ideal place for the production of heavy axion-like particles (ALPs) with mass up to 𝒪 ⁡ ( 100 ​ keV ) \mathcal{O}(100\ \mathinner{\mathrm{keV}}) range.

arxiv-2505-13989.title: When LLMs Meet Open-world Graph Learning: A New Perspective for Unlabeled Data Uncertainty
arxiv-2505-13989.creator: Yanzhe Wen, Xunkai Li, Qi Zhang, Zhu Lei, Guang Zeng, Rong-Hua Li, Guoren Wang
arxiv-2505-13989.description: Abstract Recently, large language models (LLMs) have brought a systematic transformation to the graph ML community based on text-attributed graphs (TAGs). Despite the emergence of effective frameworks, most of them fail to address data uncertainty in open-world environments, which is crucial for model deployment. Specifically, this uncertainty can be exemplified by limited labeling within large-scale data due to costly labor.

arxiv-2506-09390.title: Beyond Nash Equilibrium: Bounded Rationality of LLMs and humans in Strategic Decision-making
arxiv-2506-09390.creator: Kehan Zheng, Jinfeng Zhou, Hongning Wang, hw-ai@tsinghua.edu.cn
arxiv-2506-09390.description: Abstract Large language models are increasingly used in strategic decision-making settings, yet evidence shows that, like humans, they often deviate from full rationality. In this study, we compare LLMs and humans using experimental paradigms directly adapted from behavioral game-theory research.

pmc-10622635.creator: Digvijay D Nalawade, Pratik Wadhokar, Ajitkumar Jadhav, Prakash Chaudhary, Anishkumar Khan
pmc-10622635.description: ntricular outflow tract (LVOT) gradient of 60 mmHg at rest and moderate mitral regurgitation (MR). Further analysis of MV revealed possibility of 3 MV leaflets, abnormal ‘Mercedes-star’ appearance of MV opening and 3 papillary muscles in parasternal short-axis views (Figure 1, Movie 1).

pmc-10685849.title: Reduction-cleavable desferrioxamine B pulldown system enriches Ni(ii)-superoxide dismutase from a Streptomyces proteome†
pmc-10685849.creator: Jenny Ni, James L. Wood, Melanie Y. White, Norbert Lihi, Todd E. Markham, Joseph Wang, Peter T. Chivers, Rachel Codd
pmc-10685849.description: Two resins with the hydroxamic acid siderophore desferrioxamine B (DFOB) immobilised as a free ligand or its Fe(iii) complex were prepared to screen the Streptomyces pilosus proteome for proteins involved in siderophore-mediated Fe(iii) uptake. The resin design included a disulfide bond to enable the release of bound proteins under mild reducing conditions.

pmc-10745356.title: Pharmacological Effects of Shikonin and Its Potential in Skin Repair: A Review
pmc-10745356.creator: Yanping Song, Qiteng Ding, Yuewen Hao, Bing Cui, Chuanbo Ding, Feng Gao, Chang-Wei Hsieh, Jie Xu, Cong Wang, Andrzej Slominski
pmc-10745356.description: Currently, skin injuries have a serious impact on people’s lives and socio-economic stress. Shikonin, a naphthoquinone compound derived from the root of the traditional Chinese medicine Shikonin, has favorable biological activities such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, immunomodulatory, anticancer, and wound-healing-promoting pharmacological activities.

pmc-11455223.title: 8035 Severe Hyperglycemia Induced By Enfortumab Vedotin (EV) Treatment For Urothelial Carcinoma
pmc-11455223.creator: Noura Semreen, Michael David Goldberg
pmc-11455223.description: Disclosure: N. Semreen: None. M.D. Goldberg: None. Introduction: Immunotherapy has revolutionized cancer treatment, but it has a wide range of adverse events including endocrinopathies. Here we present a case of severe hyperglycemia induced by enfortumab vedotin (EV) treatment for advanced urothelial carcinoma. Clinical Case: A 56-year-old male was admitted to our hospital with a painful rash in sun-exposed areas.

pmc-12618801.title: An Emerging Liquid-Crystalline Conducting Polymer Thermoelectrics: Opportunities and Challenges
pmc-12618801.creator: Zhenqiang Ye, Mingdong Zhang, Junyang Deng, Lirong Liang, Chunyu Du, Guangming Chen
pmc-12618801.description: Highlights Poly(2,5-bis(3-alkylthiophen-2-yl)thieno[3,2-b]thiophene) (PBTTT) synthesis and main strategies to enhance its thermoelectric performance (including doping, composite engineering and aggregation state controlling) are comprehensively reviewed.The thermoelectric performances of PBTTT-related materials are systematically summarized and compared.Future opportunities of PBTTT thermoelectric performance enhancement and effective utilization of its unique melt processibility in multiscale regulation, composite and hybrid, and processing technology innovation are outlooked.

pmc-12621337.title: Effect of relative density on dynamic mechanical behavior and deformation mechanisms of porous titanium under coupled high-temperature and high-strain-rate conditions
pmc-12621337.creator: Dong Yang, Mingyu Li
pmc-12621337.description: The influence of relative density on the dynamic mechanical behavior of porous titanium under combined high-temperature and high-strain-rate conditions is investigated. Using validated finite element models based on three-dimensional Voronoi tessellations, simulations of Split Hopkinson Pressure Bar (SHPB) tests were conducted across a range of relative densities (0.3–0.6), strain rates (3000–8000 s−1), and temperatures (25–550 °C).

pmc-12641634.title: Compatibility Investigation of a Steroid and Two Antibiotics with Heparin for the Prevention of Catheter Occlusion in Neonatal Intensive Care Units
pmc-12641634.creator: Mao Maekawa, Masamitsu Maekawa, Yu Sato, Shimpei Watanabe, Masatoshi Saito, Nariyasu Mano, Victoria Samanidou, Verónica Pino, Natasa Kalogiouri
pmc-12641634.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Intravenous medications are frequently administered through shared catheter lines in neonatal intensive care units (NICUs) due to the limited venous access in preterm infants, raising concerns about drug incompatibilities that may cause serious complications. Hydrocortisone sodium (HDC), ampicillin (ABPC), and cefotaxime (CTX) are commonly used in NICUs and are often co-administered with unfractionated heparin (UFH), which is routinely infused to prevent catheter occlusion. This study evaluated the physicochemical compatibility of HDC, ABPC, and CTX when mixed with UFH.

pmc-13162286.title: Compliance of Aerosol Therapy with Evidence-based Guideline and Cost Incurred in Adult Critically-ill Patients: A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-13162286.creator: Ayushi R. Verma, Jignesh Shah, Sulochana Kumari, Asavari L. Raut, Steffi Abraham, Ritu Priya, Kinjal K. Patil
pmc-13162286.description: OBJECTIVEAerosol therapy is widely used in intensive care units (ICUs) for managing respiratory conditions. However, non-adherence to evidence-based guidelines can compromise outcomes and increase healthcare costs. This study evaluated the compliance of aerosol therapy with the “Indian Guidelines on Nebulization Therapy” and the cost incurred in critically ill patients.

pmc-13265611.title: When BAT Precedes BIG‐IV in Infant Botulism: The Need for Structured Antitoxin Decision‐Pathway Reporting in Case Reports
pmc-13265611.creator: Muhammad Abdullah Awan, Hammad‐ud‐din Raza
pmc-13265611.description: In infant botulism, use of equine‐derived botulinum antitoxin before BIG‐IV may be clinically justified when the infant‐specific product is delayed. Future case reports should document the treatment decision pathway, antitoxin timing, risk–benefit justification, guardian counseling, adverse‐event monitoring, and relapse‐prevention rationale to make such emergency decisions reproducible.

pmc-13356412.title: Deresuscitation Informed by Ultrasound in Patients With Septic Shock Trial
pmc-13356412.creator: Brendan Innes, Christopher Allison, Nicholas Seidler, Burton Shen, Andrew Fried, Gary Phillips, Andrew Levinson, Adeel Abbasi
pmc-13356412.description: ObjectivesThe venous excess ultrasound (VExUS) can be used at the point‐of‐care to identify venous overload and end‐organ congestion in an effort to individually tailor resuscitation and deresuscitation in patients with septic shock.MethodsWe conducted a pilot randomized controlled feasibility trial of VExUS‐guided fluid management in adult patients with septic shock. Participants were randomized to VExUS‐guided fluid management or usual care.

pmc-13397770.title: Mindset against burnout? A cross-lagged mediation analysis of growth language mindset, learning engagement, and foreign language learning burnout
pmc-13397770.creator: Zheying Xiao, Di Qiu
pmc-13397770.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundConcerns have been rising over learner burnout in foreign language learning contexts. A growth language mindset has been linked to adaptive learning outcomes. Yet, little is known about its long-term relationship with burnout and the mechanisms underlying this association.
